candidates.title: Safe Way to Upright Row #shoulderworkout
candidates.description: If you want to save your shoulders then you need stop doing upright rows with a narrow grip, standing upright and pulling the bar as high as possible and instead use an outside shoulder width grip, lean a bit forward and pull the bar up until your elbows are even with the shoulders.

candidates.title: How to properly do an upright row!
How To Properly Perform An Upright Row!
candidates.description:
How to properly perform an Upright Row!

The intention of this movement is to target your side delts.

❌If you place your hands using a close grip and pull the bar high (above your shoulders), you will start to engage your traps. 

✅Instead place your hands wider and keep your elbows in line with the shoulders at the top of the movement. 

SAVE as a reference for your next shoulder day👊🏾
